title: mail-server: Mailbox side of draft-ietf-jmap-mail-sharing (shareWith, mayShare)
description: Found building jmap-mail-sharing (decision 50): Mailbox has no typed shareWith and MailboxRights has no mayShare (both survive only in extra), and jmap-mail-server never checks mayShare. Implement per draft-ietf-jmap-mail-sharing: typed fields, the mayShare gate on shareWith changes in Mailbox/set (backend-canonical), memory backend per-user rights.
close_reason: Done in cddb8db1 (draft-ietf-jmap-mail-sharing-02): typed shareWith/mayShare, using-gated shareWith, mayShare/mayRename/mayCreateChild/mayDelete enforced under the lock, per-user isSubscribed and Mailbox/changes, MemoryBackend<C = ()> with MemoryCaller, mail-client with_mail_sharing. Not done: Email-level sharee access, ShareNotifications, principal-id validation, subscription-aware push.
